name: deepsea-azorian-history.pdf
description: Declassified-release notice (SECRET NOFORN) on the CIA's Hughes Glomar Explorer/AZORIAN program, with its acknowledged sponsorship, contractors, and 1975 media fallout, plus the broader AZORIAN operation document covering the 1974 Soviet submarine recovery, its cost, the Summa break-in and leak, and the 40 Committee and review-panel history, and the 1972–1978 SEGRE project overview of ship trials, the 1978 recovery and plutonium contamination, and mission end.
